name: Software Engineering Guide
description: An open guidebook of software engineering best practices for large developer teams, including enterprise and government: 147 chapters (called topics) across 12 parts, plus front matter and appendices, in a warm, plain, opinionated style.

conventions.topicsSegment: Translated per locale; the topics_slug column of spec/locales-for-global-sharing-with-svelte/locales.tsv
conventions.topicNumbering: Parts are whole numbers; topics are decimals (N.0 introduces part N, N.1, N.2, ... follow).
